Tandem queue with a conveyor — parts ride between stations

Parts ride a belt between an entrance, two work stations and an exit.

What to watch for

Each square is one cell of the conveyor and fills when a part occupies it, so the belt displays its own load. Cells are a resource in their own right: a part that cannot get on waits at the entry, and the queue at station 2 is what happens when the far end cannot keep up.

Underneath

This is a real run of a real model, not a recording. The page fetched the trace (616 KB gzipped) and drew it through the same renderer the desktop animation application uses. Download it and open it there to lay it out yourself.

Read the model's source — the simulation is not modified to be animated; capture is a flag on a run.
